voices.label: ES, grave y cálido (cine de animación)
voices.design: A deep, warm Latin American Spanish male narrator in his fifties, rich velvety bass voice like the Spanish-language trailers of big family animated movies: resonant but friendly, with a hint of a smile. Neutral Latin American accent. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, natural breathing, never robotic, never synthetic.

voices.label: ES, muy grave y épico
voices.design: A very deep, booming Spanish male movie trailer narrator in his forties from Spain, huge chest resonance and slow gravitas, the voice of epic blockbuster teasers dubbed in Castilian Spanish, with a slight natural grain. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, organic, never robotic, never synthetic.

voices.label: ES, grave, pícaro y moderno
voices.design: A deep, modern Latin American Spanish male voice-over artist in his thirties with a low, smooth and slightly playful tone, confident and cool, like the narrator of a bold tech product launch with humour. Neutral Latin American accent. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, relaxed, never robotic, never synthetic.

acting: Read it like the voice-over of a punchy animated movie teaser: deep, calm and confident, short sentences that land on the beat, real pauses between sentences. Slightly mysterious at the start, a knowing smile on « alguien le responde », energy rising through the list, and a big, warm, unforgettable final line. Never shouting, never rushed, never theatrical; sounds like a real actor in a real studio.
